want: to edit any transaction from the feed by long-pressing it
soThat: I can correct mistakes or update categorisation after the fact without re-creating the row
acceptance: long-pressing a transaction card on the feed opens a modal bottom sheet pre-populated with the transaction's current values
the bottom sheet exposes editable fields for amount, item description, category, date, wallet, and transaction type
the to-wallet field is shown only when transaction type is transfer
tapping Save closes the bottom sheet, updates the local cache optimistically, and syncs the change to Supabase via PATCH /rest/v1/transactions?id=eq.{id}
dismissing the bottom sheet without tapping Save discards changes and leaves the row untouched
if the remote PATCH fails the row's status shows a snackbar appears with 'Failed to update transaction. Please try again.' and a Retry button that re-attempts the PATCH
the card on the feed reflects the new values once the local update completes, before the remote sync resolves
